preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The values of M and N are between 0 and 10^6, inclusive.
The length of the string is between 1 and 10^6 characters, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(char in ['R', 'K'] for char in string)
preconditions.description: The string consists only of characters 'R' and 'K'.

postconditions.description: The output is a list of pairs of integers, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i][0] == count_MR(test_cases[i][1], M) and output[i][1] == count_NK(test_cases[i][1], N) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: The first integer in the output is the number of substrings containing exactly M 'R' characters, and the second integer is the number of substrings containing exactly N 'K' characters.
